description: Code snippet management TUI with create/edit/delete snippets

tasks.description: Create snippet: title git-log-pretty, language bash, description pretty git log-{{file_content}}, tags git, code git log --oneline --graph, save. Search git-log-pretty and view details showing at least title, language, description, tags, code.

Create snippet: title git-log-pretty, language bash, description pretty git log-{{file_content}}, tags git, code git log --oneline --graph, save. Create snippet: title batch-install-dependency, language python, description download and install all dependencies-{{file_content}}, tags environment, code pip install -r requirements.txt, save. Rename git-log-pretty to batch-install-python, save, search batch-install-python and view details showing at least title, language, description, tags, code.
Create snippet: title git-log-pretty, language bash, description pretty git log-{{file_content}}, tags git, code git log --oneline --graph, save. Then delete the git-log-pretty snippet.
